control.title: Security metrics and monitoring of the programme
control.description: Define and track security metrics (open vulnerabilities, training completion, access review completion) and report them to leadership.

evidence_hint: Quarterly metrics report or dashboard export.
acceptance_criteria: Security metrics with values for a recent period
The metrics were reviewed or reported to management

criteria_coverage.criterion: Security metrics with values for a recent period
The metrics were reviewed or reported to management

requirements.title: KRIs, KPIs and reporting of assessments
requirements.guidance: Define key risk and performance indicators monitored by the Board sub-committee, and table audit and VA/PT reports at its next meeting.

requirements.title: Relevant, quality information
requirements.guidance: Generate and use quality information to support internal control.

requirements.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
requirements.guidance: Evaluate whether controls are present and functioning, for example internal audits and pen tests.

requirements.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
requirements.guidance: Decide what to measure, how and when, and evaluate ISMS effectiveness.
